_note: TOPIC-TAGGING-1104 (owner design 2026-11-04; migration 017 DRAFT, NOT applied). enabled must be literally true AND 017 applied (a missing 017 pauses the worker) AND micro_topic.registry_table.read_from_db literally true (TT-R6 A2: the tagger and the digest then read the same DB registry); default OFF. Tagging never runs inline in ingest or /ask (owner: 'some processes are non-blocking'): one background worker thread. Free Groq entries only (price 0). calls_per_minute is the PROVIDER bound (set it to the free-tier allowance published for the chosen Groq model; PROVISIONAL, not measured). min_score 0.5, bm25_threshold 2.0 (copied from micro_topic count_min_score), bm25_fallback_after_failures 0 (fallback OFF, see R4) and max_failures 5 are PROVISIONAL planner priors, uncalibrated (calibration rule): recalibrate on the first backfill's score distribution and failure counts. tagger_version names the prompt/logic; a change does NOT re-tag tagged parts (no automatic re-tag). propose_new_topics: also needs micro_topic.registry_table.registration_enabled true (owner decision). tokens_per_minute: 0 = call pacing only; set it to the model's published free-tier tokens/minute (UNVERIFIED value, check the Groq console) so pacing stays under both limits. R1: tag_chunkless_sources (default false, owner decision D4): sources with no stored full-text parts are not tagged or counted as tagged. Provider timeouts/5xx and 429 are not attempts: a process-wide cooldown (transient_cooldown_s, Retry-After capped at max_retry_after_s); the backfill CLI stops when asked to wait longer than backfill_stop_cooldown_s. Keep calls_per_minute and tokens_per_minute BELOW the free-tier allowance so /ask keeps headroom on the shared free quota. R4: bm25_fallback_after_failures 0 = BM25 fallback OFF until the T9 calibration note (no lexical tag from a failed model reply). min_active_roots 20 is a planner default (optional extra, NOT an owner-set limit; D2 is not yet decided): nothing is tagged until the DB registry has that many ACTIVE top-level topics, because with too few roots every part would end as a terminal no_topic; the owner sets or lowers it with D2. R5: a malformed DB enabled row pauses (fail closed); the backfill CLI stops when the provider asks for more than max_retry_after_s. Owner control rows in the DB (LISTS-TO-DB 016 list topic_tagging.control, payload {"value": x}; keys enabled, limits_confirmed, calls_per_minute, tokens_per_minute, concurrency, batch) are polled every control_poll_s: DB enabled false pauses tagging without a restart; without the 016 view this file alone applies. Each poll merges the DB rows onto this file's values, so a deleted row reverts to the file value (TT-R6 A3). digest_signal_min_s: at most one digest rebuild signal per this many seconds.
